entries.title: Job 4:1
segments: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

entries.title: Job 4:2
segments: If one assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

entries.title: Job 4:3
segments: Behold, thou hast instructed many, And thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

entries.title: Job 4:4
segments: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, And thou hast made firm the feeble knees.

entries.title: Job 4:5
segments: But now it is come unto thee, and thou faintest; It toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

entries.title: Job 4:6
segments: Is not thy fear [of God] thy confidence, [And] the integrity of thy ways thy hope?

entries.title: Job 4:7
segments: Remember, I pray thee, who [ever] perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

entries.title: Job 4:8
segments: According as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, And sow trouble, reap the same.

entries.title: Job 4:9
segments: By the breath of God they perish, And by the blast of his anger are they consumed.

entries.title: Job 4:10
segments: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, And the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

entries.title: Job 4:11
segments: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, And the whelps of the lioness are scattered abroad.

entries.title: Job 4:12
segments: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, And mine ear received a whisper thereof.

entries.title: Job 4:13
segments: In thoughts from the visions of the night, When deep sleep falleth on men,

entries.title: Job 4:14
segments: Fear came upon me, and trembling, Which made all my bones to shake.

entries.title: Job 4:15
segments: Then a spirit passed before my face; The hair of my flesh stood up.

entries.title: Job 4:16
segments: It stood still, but I could not discern the appearance thereof; A form was before mine eyes: [There was] silence, and I heard a voice, [saying],

entries.title: Job 4:17
segments: Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

entries.title: Job 4:18
segments: Behold, he putteth no trust in his servants; And his angels he chargeth with folly:

entries.title: Job 4:19
segments: How much more them that dwell in houses of clay, Whose foundation is in the dust, Who are crushed before the moth!

entries.title: Job 4:20
segments: Betwixt morning and evening they are destroyed: They perish for ever without any regarding it.

entries.title: Job 4:21
segments: Is not their tent-cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.
